_about: New Game Plus disposition table (List 13 #122). PROPOSED — NOT CANON: no canon source rules that a second-cycle mode exists. The table rules every section of #96's real save payload (plus the sections later packages added) exactly once: persist, reset, or follows-a-ruling. Two rulings belong to the owner and are NOT taken here: the dex ruling (completion is DERIVED from the bitsets per #14, so persisting bitsets IS persisting completion — the spec refuses to dress this up as a third option) and the roster ruling (three documented shapes with consequences spelled out in the spec). Story-locked individuals (#68) are never silently deleted by a cycle transition under any shape: carried or archived, accounted for by id in the transition's cycle report.

dispositions.dex_bitsets: OWNER RULING — persist or reset; completion (#14) re-derives from whichever is chosen
dispositions.flags_progress: reset — gates test flags (#11); a run whose doors start open is not a run
dispositions.flags_tech: follows the roster ruling (#117 held/performed split)
dispositions.hallOfFame (#126): persist — per-run snapshots carry their cycle number
dispositions.meta: persist + increment the one proposed field: cycle
dispositions.research_facts (#97): follows the dex ruling — the two dex-adjacent systems may not contradict
dispositions.roster: OWNER RULING — full carry | partner-only carry | no carry (see spec for consequences, incl. story-locked fates under partner-only)
dispositions.world_overrides: reset — #124 rotation re-derives them from the clock

proposed_field.cycle: additive field on #96's meta section; absent = cycle 1 under #96's absent = default rule, so pre-NG+ saves need no migration

scaling.mechanism: NG+ overlay tables at roll time — #113's swarm-overlay machinery keyed to cycle instead of clock; #52's law (wild bands never read party state) is NOT repealed
scaling.warning: #100 rematch ladders + #87 rematches already scale the first run's postgame; NG+ scaling must be ruled against that baseline, not stacked on it
